biggest_catch: Strict eligibility (18-35 or 65+, no cardiovascular/respiratory/metabolic/neurological symptoms, no pharmacological treatment, nonsmoker) plus simulated altitude exposure; you must come to Purdue University.
catches: Strict eligibility: 18-35 or 65+, free of cardiovascular/respiratory/metabolic/neurological symptoms, no regular medication or exercise program, nonsmoker, no altitude exposure in last 6 months.
Involves simulated altitude exposure with heart, blood vessel, and respiration monitoring; physiological risk disclosed.
No compensation if none of the visits are completed.
$250 requires completing all three visits; partial payment of $50/$100 for first/remaining visits.

eligibility: Ages 18-35 or 65+; free from symptoms of cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, or neurological disease; not under pharmacological treatment or a regular exercise program; nonsmoker; no altitude exposure in last 6 months; no allergy to medical adhesives. Study conducted by Igor Fernandes, assistant professor in the Department of Health and Kinesiology. IRB-2023-1048.

steps: Email researcher Qudus Ojikutu at qojikutu@purdue.edu or call 765-409-4097 to apply.
Complete screening for the eligibility criteria.
Attend three experimental sessions: ~1 hour (first) and ~4 hours each (second and third) with physiological monitoring under simulated altitude.
Receive $250 for completing all three visits (partial payments if you withdraw).
timing: Three experimental sessions: ~1 hour for the first, ~4 hours each for the second and third.
